contract_plain_english: Equation (1.11) prescribes Riemann initial data: at time zero, the state equals a fixed left state at every negative position and a fixed right state at every positive position. The interface is chosen as zero, and its value is unspecified. The chapter supplies a real vector-valued state convention. The surrounding prose describes a single jump, although the displayed equation does not explicitly require distinct states. This initial-data prescription accompanies a hyperbolic equation and is not itself an evolution or solvability claim [printed page 1, state convention following (1.1); printed page 5, Section 1.2.1, opening paragraph and (1.11)].
